blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Scientific figures often encode quantitative results that are not readily available in machine-readable form, making accurate plot digitization important for verifying and reusing published findings. Yet it remains unclear how accurately current models recover plotted values from real scientific figures, as existing benchmarks rely largely on synthetic charts or cover only a limited range of chart types.
We introduce PlotGround , an automated pipeline for building plot digitization benchmarks from real scientific figures and their author-released source data.
PlotGround maps figures to source tables, identifies reconstructable panels, and generates quantitative questions with source-grounded reference values.
We use PlotGround to construct PlotGround-1k , a human-verified benchmark of 1,119 questions from 1,066 bioRxiv preprints. 1 1 1 The PlotGround pipeline and PlotGround-1k will be released upon acceptance. Across sixteen multimodal models, the best reaches 87.5% accuracy at a ± 5 % \pm 5\% relative-error tolerance. Tightening the tolerance to ± 2 % \pm 2\% lowers every model’s accuracy by 11–24 percentage points, revealing a gap between approximate visual reading and precise quantitative recovery.
PlotGround’s paired figure–source structure lets us compare how accurately the same values are recovered from figures and from source tables. Providing source tables instead of figures raises a coding agent’s accuracy from 90.0% to 97.4% while cutting cost by 72%.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Scientific figures typically sit at the end of rich computational pipelines: raw measurements may be filtered, normalized, and statistically summarized before the resulting quantities are rendered visually ( Peng, 2011 ; Sandve et al., 2013 ; Wilson et al., 2017 ) . Yet when an AI agent reads a paper, pixels are often all it gets. Recovering the underlying numerical values from those pixels, known as plot digitization, is therefore a basic prerequisite for quantitative analysis over scientific figures ( Savva et al., 2011 ; Rohatgi, 2017 ; Liu et al., 2023a ) .
blocks.zh: 科学数字一般坐落在丰富的计算管道的尽头:原始测量可能经过过滤,规范化,在生成数量之前进行统计总结(Peng,2011;Sandve等,2013;Wilson等,2017.). 然而当一个AI代理读取一纸时,像素常常是它得到的. 因此,从这些像素中取回基本的数值,即图示数字化,是科学数字定量分析的基本先决条件(Savva等,2011;Rohatgi,2017;Liu等,2023a)。

blocks.en: The reliability of this step becomes increasingly consequential as multimodal models and coding agents are deployed for scientific tasks. They are expected not only to ingest papers but also to verify reported findings and reproduce analyses ( Skarlinski et al., 2024 ; Siegel et al., 2024 ; Starace et al., 2025 ) . Figures often contain key evidence supporting a paper’s claims ( Roberts et al., 2024 ; Sun and Xiao, 2026 ) , and even small digitization errors can silently propagate into subsequent analysis and conclusions.
blocks.zh: 随着为科学任务部署多式模型和编码剂,这一步骤的可靠性就变得日益严重。 期望它们不仅吸收论文,而且核实所报告的调查结果并复制分析(Skarlinski等,2024;Siegel等,2024;Starace等,2025)。 数字往往包含支持论文索赔的关键证据(Roberts等,2024;Sun和Xiao,2026),即使是小的数字化错误也能默默地传播到后来的分析和结论中去.

blocks.en: Despite these stakes, we still know little about how accurately current models recover numerical values from real scientific figures. Existing digitization benchmarks offer limited guidance here because they have largely relied on synthetically rendered charts ( Methani et al., 2020 ; Hassan et al., 2023 ; Xia et al., 2025 ; Berkane et al., 2026 ) or covered only a limited set of chart types ( Luo et al., 2021 ; Touhidul Islam et al., 2026 ) . Synthetic rendering provides exact ground truth and controllable visual variation, but it does not fully capture the characteristics of real scientific figures, including multi-panel layouts, heterogeneous chart types, dense legends and annotations, and varied axis conventions. As a result, performance on these benchmarks may not reflect performance on figures encountered in scientific papers.
blocks.zh: 尽管存在这些利害关系,我们对于目前的模型如何准确地从真正的科学数字中恢复数值仍然所知甚少。 现有的数字化基准在这方面提供了有限的指导,因为它们主要依靠合成图(Methani等,2020年;Hassan等,2023年;Xia等,2025年;Berkane等,2026年),或只涵盖有限的图型(Luo等,2021年;Touhidul Islam等,2026年)。 合成渲染提供了精确的地真和可控的视觉变异,但并不能完全捕捉到真实科学人物的特征,包括多板块布局,不同的图表类型,密集的传说和说明,以及不同的轴相会. 因此,这些基准的绩效可能不能反映科学论文所遇到数字的绩效。

blocks.en:
We introduce PlotGround , an automated pipeline for constructing plot digitization benchmarks directly from scientific papers and their author-released source data.
Our key observation is that many papers already deposit the data behind their figures, but what is missing is an explicit mapping from source data to the plotted quantities.
Unlike synthetic benchmarks that render numerical data into plots, PlotGround starts from real scientific figures and works backward. It reconstructs the plotted quantities from the corresponding source data to provide grounded reference values.
The resulting figure–data pairs also allow us to query the same quantities from either the rendered figure or the source table, isolating how the representation of evidence affects agent performance (Section 4.5 ).

blocks.en: Building on PlotGround, we construct PlotGround-1k, a human-verified benchmark of 1,119 quantitative questions from 1,066 bioRxiv preprints. Our evaluation shows strong performance among frontier models: GPT-5.6 Sol reaches 87.5% accuracy at a ± 5 % \pm 5\% tolerance, and four of the 16 models exceed 80%. However, accuracy drops by 11–24 percentage points under a stricter ± 2 % \pm 2\% tolerance, indicating a remaining gap in numerical precision. During human verification, we also find 8 figures whose plotted values disagree with those reconstructed from their own deposited source data (Section 4.6 ). These cases suggest that accurate plot digitization could help flag inconsistencies between scientific figures and their source data.

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: • A source-grounded construction pipeline. We introduce PlotGround, an automated pipeline that turns real scientific figures into digitization benchmarks by grounding plotted values in author-released source data. • A realistic benchmark with paired evidence representations. We construct PlotGround-1k, a human-verified benchmark of 1,119 quantitative questions over real scientific figures. Each question is linked to the source table from which its reference value is computed, enabling controlled comparisons between figures and source data as evidence. • A characterization of the precision gap in scientific plot digitization. We find that frontier models perform strongly under a ± 5 % \pm 5\% tolerance, but accuracy drops by 11–24 percentage points at ± 2 % \pm 2\% . In an agentic setting, recovering the same quantities from source tables is more precise than estimating them from figures.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Recent work has increasingly explored AI agents for scientific tasks spanning literature synthesis ( Asai et al., 2026 ) , research-idea generation ( Si et al., 2025 ; Baek et al., 2025 ) , experiment execution ( Boiko et al., 2023 ; Si et al., 2026 ) , and the replication or verification of published results ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Siegel et al., 2024 ) .
As these systems move beyond text-only interaction, they increasingly operate over heterogeneous scientific artifacts, including papers, code, tables, and figures ( Khalighinejad et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2026 ) .
This creates a particular challenge for verification and reproducibility workflows, where recovering reported quantitative results may require locating and interpreting figures ( Siegel et al., 2024 ) .
Our work focuses on this interface, studying the extraction of numerical information from scientific figures and how its representation affects downstream agent performance.
blocks.zh:
最近的工作越来越多地探索了AI代理,以完成涵盖文学合成的科学任务(Asai等,2026年),研究理想生成(Si等,2025年;Baek等,2025年),实验执行(Boiko等,2023年;Si等,2026年),以及复制或核实已公布的结果(Hu等,2025年;Siegel等,2024年)。
由于这些系统超越了仅文本的相互作用,它们越来越多地在包括论文、代码、表格和数字在内的各种科学文物上运作(Khalighiinejad等,2025;Lu等,2026)。
这给核查和可复制性工作流程带来了特别的挑战,在这项工作中,恢复报告的量化结果可能需要查找和解释数字(Siegel等人,2024年)。
我们的工作侧重于这一接口,研究从科学数字中提取数字信息的情况,以及其表述如何影响下游剂性能。

blocks.en:
Plot digitization aims to recover the numerical values encoded by visual marks in a rendered chart,
ranging from interactive tools ( Jung et al., 2017 ; Rohatgi, 2017 ) to fully automated extraction methods ( Liu et al., 2023a ; Liu et al., 2023b ; Yang et al., 2025 ) . However, existing extraction benchmarks often rely on automatically rendered charts or cover only a limited set of chart types ( Hassan et al., 2023 ; Xia et al., 2025 ) . PlotQA uses real-world tabular data but automatically generates the chart images ( Methani et al., 2020 ) ; ExcelChart400K uses authentic charts collected from public Excel files but covers only bar, line, and pie charts ( Luo et al., 2021 ) .
Newer benchmarks have begun to move toward real-world figures, but important limitations remain. ChartZero constructs a 1,000-chart benchmark mined from heterogeneous PDFs but restricts evaluation to line charts ( Touhidul Islam et al., 2026 ) . SPUR and CharXiv evaluate models on real scientific figures, but through multiple-choice or descriptive and reasoning questions rather than open-ended recovery of plotted values ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Ding et al., 2026 ) .
Our benchmark addresses these gaps by evaluating open-ended numerical recovery across diverse real scientific figures, with ground-truth values derived from author-released source data.
blocks.zh:
拼图数字化旨在恢复由可视标记编码的图中的数字值,
从互动工具(Jung等,2017;Rohatgi,2017)到完全自动化取出方法(Liu等,2023a; 刘等,2023b;杨等,2025.). 然而,现有的提取基准往往依赖于自动制成的图表,或只涵盖有限的一组图表类型(Hassan等人,2023;Xia等人,2025)。 PlotQA使用真实世界的表格数据,但自动生成图表图像(Methani等,2020年;ExcelChart400K使用从公开的Excel文件中收集但只覆盖栏,行,和饼图的正版图表(Luo等,2021年).
新的基准已开始向现实世界的数字发展,但仍然存在重大限制。 ChartZero从不同的PDF中绘制出1 000个图表基准,但评价仅限于行图(Touhidul Islam等,2026年)。 SPUR和CharXiv对真实科学人物的模型进行评估,但通过多重选择或描述和推理问题,而不是开放式地恢复所绘制的数值(Wang等,2024;Ding等,2026.).
我们的基准通过评价各种真实科学数字的开放式数字恢复,从作者释放的来源数据中得出地面真实值,来弥补这些差距。

blocks.en: 3 PlotGround
blocks.zh: 3 个绘图

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of the PlotGround pipeline. Given a bioRxiv paper organized as a filesystem (manuscript, figures, and supplementary source tables), Mapping proposes candidate figure–table bindings from textual evidence such as captions and in-text references; Grounding retains only panels whose values can be reliably reconstructed and records a reconstruction recipe, rejecting ambiguous ones; Synthesis follows the recipe, validates the recomputed values, and writes questions using only figure-visible labels. For clarity, the example shows a single panel with question text abbreviated. Real figures are typically multi-panel and are given to models in full (Appendix A.2 ).
blocks.zh: 图1 地铁管道概况. 鉴于BioRxiv文件被组织成一个文件系统(手稿、数字和补充源表),绘图从文字证据(如标题和文字参考文献)中提出候选的图表-表格绑定; 地平线只保留其价值可以可靠地重建并记录重建方法的面板,拒绝模棱两可的方法; 合成遵循方法,验证重算的数值,并且只使用数字可见的标签来写问题。 为明确起见,示例显示一个有问题文本缩写的单一面板. 实际数字一般为多层,并全部提供给模型(附录A.2.)。

blocks.en: 3.1 Pipeline Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 管道概况

blocks.en: PlotGround turns a scientific figure and its corresponding source data into grounded quantitative questions. Each question refers to a visible element in the figure, such as a bar, labeled point, or box, and asks for its numerical value. The answer is recomputed from the underlying source table rather than read from the rendered image. We evaluate digitization at the level of individual plotted values , allowing each answer to be verified against its source data and scored independently.
blocks.zh: PlotGround将一个科学数字及其相应的源数据转化为有根据的定量问题. 每个问题是指图中一个可见元素,如条,被标记的点,或框,并询问其数值. 答案是从基础源表重算,而不是从渲染的图像中读取. 我们评价数字化的单个绘图值,

blocks.en: PlotGround operates in three stages (Figure 1 ). Mapping identifies candidate source tables for each scientific figure. Grounding examines each mapped figure at the panel level, retaining only panels whose plotted values can be reliably reconstructed and recording a reconstruction recipe specifying the operations needed to recover them. Synthesis follows these recipes to compute reference values and generates panel-specific quantitative questions.
blocks.zh: PlotGround分三个阶段运作(图一. 绘制每个科学人物的候选来源表。 在小组一级对每个绘图数字进行打地盘检查,只保留其绘图值可以可靠地重建的小组,并记录一份重建方案,具体说明恢复这些图所需的行动。 综合遵循这些配方来计算参考值并产生专门小组的量化问题.

blocks.en: All three stages are executed by Claude Code ( Anthropic, 2026a ) using its default tool set, which allows the agent to navigate and read files, inspect spreadsheets, and execute code. We use Claude Opus 5 for the grounding stage and Claude Sonnet 5 for mapping and synthesis. Each paper is processed in an isolated working directory containing only the files associated with that paper.
blocks.zh: 所有三个阶段都由克洛德代码(Anthropic, 2026a)使用它的默认工具集来执行,这使得代理机能够导航并读取文件,检查电子表格,并执行代码. 我们使用克洛德·奥普斯5进行地平起落阶段,克洛德·索内特5进行绘图和合成. 每份文件都用一个单独的工作目录处理,其中只载有与该文件有关的文件。

blocks.en: 3.2 Figure–Source Mapping
blocks.zh: 3.2 图 - 来源绘图

blocks.en: The mapping stage identifies candidate supplementary source data for each scientific figure. The agent navigates the working directory and infers figure–source correspondences from the manuscript, captions, and spreadsheet summaries.
blocks.zh: 绘图阶段确定每个科学人物的候选补充源数据。 代理浏览工作目录,并推断出来自手稿、标题和电子表格摘要的图表来源。

blocks.en: The agent proposes figure–source bindings supported by either direct evidence, such as an explicit textual reference connecting a figure to a supplementary file, or indirect evidence, such as a match between the figure description and the contents of a candidate table. When the available evidence explicitly identifies a specific panel, the correspondence may be resolved at the panel level; otherwise, it is retained at the figure level and further disambiguated during grounding.
blocks.zh: 代理人提出图 - 来源约束,有直接证据作为佐证,如将图与补充文件联系起来的明确文字参考,有间接证据,如图描述与候选表内容相匹配。 如果现有证据明确确定一个专门小组,可在小组一级解决函证问题;否则,函证保留在数字一级,并在搁浅时进一步混淆。

blocks.en: 3.3 Panel-Level Grounding
blocks.zh: 3.3 小组级别

blocks.en: Given a candidate figure–source mapping, the grounding stage determines which panels can be reliably reconstructed from the linked source data. Grounding is intentionally conservative: a panel is retained only when its plotted quantity can be recovered with simple, well-defined operations and when the correspondence between visual elements and source-table entries is unambiguous.
blocks.zh: 鉴于一个候选数字-来源映射,地基阶段决定了哪些面板可以可靠地从链接的源数据中重建. 地平面是有意保守的:只有用简单、明确定义的操作才能取回所绘制的数量,并且视觉要素与源表条目之间的对应关系明确时,才保留面板。

blocks.en: The stage first applies a reliability gate . We retain quantitative charts whose plotted values can be recovered from the source table using basic operations such as selection, aggregation, ratios, and logarithmic transformations. Panels are rejected when reconstruction requires domain-specific analyses, lacks figure-visible identifiers for question construction, or leaks exact values through printed annotations.
blocks.zh: 舞台首先采用了可靠性门。 我们保留了定量图表,其绘图值可以通过选择、汇总、比率和对数转换等基本操作从源表恢复。 当重建需要特定领域分析时,小组会被拒绝,没有用于质疑构建的可显示数字的识别符,或者通过印刷说明泄露出准确的值.

blocks.en: For each retained panel, the agent maps visual groups to explicit rows or columns in the source table and records a structured reconstruction recipe specifying the relevant sheet, columns, row filters, and any aggregation or normalization. Every mapping must be anchored to literal evidence, such as a table header, a category-column value, or a token visible in the figure. Mappings based on domain priors, conventional ordering, or sample-ID ordinals are disallowed. Panels with ambiguous column choices (e.g., raw versus adjusted p -values), unidentified normalization references, or incomplete source-data coverage are also rejected.
blocks.zh: 对于每个被保留的面板,代理人会将视觉组映射到源表的清晰行或列上,并记录一个结构化的重建配方,指定相关的工作表,列,行过滤器,以及任何聚合或正常化. 每一个映射都必须被固定在文字上的证据上,例如表头,分类栏值,或者图中可见的符号. 根据域名前传、常规定购或样本识别规范绘制的地图是不允许的。 存在模棱两可的列选择(例如原始与调整后p-values),不明正常化引用,或不完整的源数据覆盖的面板也被否决.

blocks.en: 3.4 Question Synthesis
blocks.zh: 3.4 问题综述

blocks.en: The synthesis stage follows the recorded reconstruction recipe on the source table to recompute the plotted values. It then matches these values to the individually readable elements of each panel: bar heights, line or survival values at labeled x positions, the marked statistics of a box plot (median and quartiles), and the coordinates of in-figure-labeled points in scatter and volcano plots.
blocks.zh: 合成阶段遵循了源表所记录的重建配方来重算所绘制的数值. 然后将这些值与每个面板的个别可读元素相匹配:贴有标签的x位置的栏高、线或存活值、一盒地块(中间地块和四角地块)的标记统计值,以及散落地块和火山地块中图标点的坐标。

blocks.en:
Before generating questions, it checks that the recipe’s assumptions are supported by explicit evidence in the source file or paper. It also verifies that the recomputed values satisfy basic constraints of the plotted quantity (e.g., survival probabilities must be non-increasing over time). As a final guard against incorrect figure–source mappings, the agent reads each target off the figure and discards it only when the reading differs from the recomputed value by a large margin (at least three times the ± 5 % \pm 5\% tolerance used for evaluation).
Among the elements that pass these checks, it selects the clearest target in each panel, favoring large, uncrowded marks.
blocks.zh:
在提出问题之前,它检查食谱的假设是否有来源文件或文件中的明确证据支持。 它还验证了重算值满足了所规划数量的基本限制(例如生存概率必须随时间推移而无增长). 作为防止不正确的数字-来源映射的最终戒备,代理只有在读取值与重算值相差很大(至少是用于评价的± 5%\pm 5%的容忍度的三倍)时,才将每个目标从数字上读出并丢弃.
在通过这些检查的元素中,它在每个面板中选择最清晰的目标,偏好大而无人群的标记.

blocks.en: Each question asks for a single numerical value and names its target using only identifiers visible in the figure, such as the panel label, an x-tick or legend entry, and the axis label and units, e.g., “In panel b, what is the mean head-twitch count at 1 mg/kg?” (Figure 1 ). This ensures that questions can be answered from the figure alone without access to the source data. To reduce redundancy, synthesis emits at most two questions per figure, drawn from different panels. Additional examples, shown with their full multi-panel figures and spanning different chart types, are provided in Appendix A.2 .
blocks.zh: 每个问题都询问一个单一的数字值,并且只使用图中可见的标识符来命名其目标,如面板标签,一个x-tick或传奇条目,以及轴标签和单位等,如"在面板b中,1 mg/kg的平均头抽搐计数是什么?" (图1). 这就确保了问题能够仅从数字中解答,而无法获得源数据。 为了减少冗余,合成从不同的面板中抽取的每个数字最多发出两个问题。 附录A.2提供了其他例子,包括完整的多小组数字和不同的图表类型。

blocks.en: 4.1 Benchmark Construction
blocks.zh: 4.1 基准建设

blocks.en: We build PlotGround on the 2025 bioRxiv corpus available through Paperclip 2 2 2 https://paperclip.gxl.ai/ , an agent-native interface to scientific literature that exposes papers in a filesystem-like environment. This representation gives coding agents direct access to the components of a paper, including the manuscript, figures, and deposited supplementary files, and allows them to navigate and reason over these artifacts programmatically. We focus on bioRxiv because source-data deposition is common in biology, making it possible to link published figures to the underlying tables from which their values can be reconstructed.
blocks.zh: 我们通过Paperclip 2 2 2 https://paperclip.gxl.ai/建立2025年生物Rxiv活体图集,这是科学文献的代理-内在界面,在类似文件系统的环境中揭露论文。 这种表述方式使编码人员能够直接查阅文件的组成部分,包括手稿、数字和交存的补充文件,并使他们可以按程序对这些文物进行导航和解释。 我们把重点放在生物Rxiv上,因为源数据沉积在生物学中很常见,因此可以将已公布的数字与据以重建其价值的基础表格联系起来。

blocks.en: We require each paper to contain at least one machine-readable tabular supplement ( .xlsx , .xls , .csv , or .tsv ), as these formats provide structured source data that is well suited to direct figure reconstruction. Among 37,635 preprints with non-empty supplements, 10,540 satisfy this criterion, and all of them enter the pipeline.
blocks.zh: 我们要求每份文件至少包含一个机器可读的表格补充(.xlsx,.xls.,.csv.或.tsv.),因为这些格式提供了结构化的源数据,非常适合直接进行数字重建. 在37,635个有非空附加品的预印品中,有10,540个符合这个标准,全部进入了管道.

blocks.en: The corpus then passes through the three stages in Sections 3.2 – 3.4 . Mapping identifies 28,536 figure–source bindings across 8,197 papers. To control cost, we keep at most one mapping per paper and randomly sample 7,487 of the 8,197 papers for downstream processing. Grounding evaluates the sampled mappings, covering 22,541 figure panels in total. Among them, 3,894 panels from 1,568 figures admit a valid reconstruction recipe. Synthesis generates at most two questions per figure, and figures that do not admit a suitable question yield none. When a figure has two questions targeting panels of the same chart type, we remove one at random, leaving 1,205 candidates. We manually audit all of them and retain 1,119 verified questions from 1,066 papers, which constitute PlotGround-1k (see Appendix A.3 for the verification protocol). Table 1 summarizes the resulting counts.
blocks.zh: 然后,在3.2至3.4分节中经过三个阶段。 测绘确定了28,536个数字-来源捆绑,覆盖了8,197个文件。 为了控制成本,我们每张纸最多保存一张地图,并随机抽样8,197份纸中的7,487份,供下游处理。 地平面评估了所抽样的地平面图,共覆盖了22,541个图板. 其中,来自1 568位数字的3 894个面板承认了有效的重建方法。 综合每个数字产生最多两个问题,不接受适当问题的数字不产生任何问题。 当一个数字有两个问题针对同一图表类型的小组时,我们随机删除一个,留下1 205名候选人。 我们对所有文件进行人工审计,并保留了1 066份文件中的1 119个经核实的问题,这些问题构成PlotGround-1k(核查议定书见附录A.3)。 表1汇总了由此产生的数字。

blocks.en: 4.4 Qualitative Error Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.4 定性错误分析

blocks.en: To better understand where current models fail, we manually inspect representative incorrect predictions across the evaluated models. We observe several recurring error patterns that are not apparent from aggregate accuracy alone. In particular, many failures arise from converting visual position into precise numerical values, especially when interpolation between labeled ticks is required.
blocks.zh: 为了更好地了解当前模型的故障之处,我们手动检查所有被评价模型中有代表性的不正确的预测. 我们观察到若干反复出现的错误模式,仅从总的准确性来看并不明显。 特别是,许多失败都是由将视觉位置转换为精确的数值而来,特别是在需要被标记的勾点之间的插值时.

blocks.en: Reading a value from a logarithmic axis requires geometric interpolation between labeled ticks, which is a frequent source of error among the cases we inspected. Models generally recognize that the axis is logarithmic, but struggle to convert a target’s visual position into the correct numerical value when it falls between labeled ticks. On a log scale, small positional errors can translate into much larger relative numerical errors because equal distances correspond to equal ratios between values. For example, predicting 300 300 for a gold value of 252.59 252.59 yields a relative error of approximately 19 % 19\% (Figure 3 a), despite the prediction appearing visually close to the plotted point.
blocks.zh: 从对数轴读取一个值,需要在被标记的勾中进行几何插值,这是我们所检查的案例中经常出错的一个出错源. 模型一般承认轴是对数的,但当目标在被标记的勾勾之间掉入时会努力将目标的视觉位置转换成正确的数值. 在日志尺度上,小位置误差可以被转换成大得多的相对数值误差,因为等距离对应于数值之间的等比. 例如,预计黄金值为252.59 252.59的300 300美元将得出大约19%的相对误差(图3a),尽管这一预测似乎与绘图点相近。

blocks.en:
Predictions often concentrate on labeled tick values, even when the target lies visibly between or beyond them. In a horizontal bar chart (Figure 3 b) whose x x -axis is labeled at 0 0 , 1 1 , 2 2 , 3 3 and 4 4 , the target bar has a gold value of 4.99 4.99 and visibly extends past the final gridline. Eight of sixteen models nevertheless answered exactly 4 4 , the last labeled tick. Only three read the overshoot and answered 5 5 , two gave intermediate values ( 4.2 4.2 and 4.5 4.5 ), and the remaining three were further off ( 3 3 , 20 20 , and 40 40 ).
This behavior is consistent with models estimating the target relative to the nearest tick and then reporting that tick, or a nearby round number. As a result, accuracy may depend on where the gold value lies relative to the axis labels: values close to ticks are often recovered correctly, whereas values between ticks are more error-prone.

这种行为与模型估计目标相对于最接近的勾选,然后报告该勾选,或附近的圆数一致. 因此,准确性可能取决于黄金值相对于轴标签的位置:靠近勾的值往往被正确回收,而勾之间的值则更容易出错.

blocks.en: 4.5 Effect of Evidence Representation
blocks.zh: 4.5 证据陈述的效果

blocks.en: The evaluations above measure plot digitization in its purest form: a model is shown a figure and a question, without access to the surrounding paper or source data. Recent work on scientific agents, however, has begun to move beyond the paper as a single static document, exposing agents to broader collections of research artifacts ( Miao et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . In such settings, the same quantitative evidence may also be available in structured source data. This raises a basic question for agentic scientific reasoning: how much does the representation of quantitative evidence affect an agent’s ability to recover and use it?
blocks.zh: 上述评价以最纯正的形式衡量图解数字化:一个模型显示一个数字和一个问题,而不访问周围的纸张或源数据. 然而,最近关于科学代理人的工作已经开始超越了作为单一静态文件的论文,使代理人接触到更广泛的研究文物收藏(Miao等,2025;Liu等,2026). 在这种情况下,结构化源数据中也可能有同样的定量证据。 这为代理人科学推理提出了一个基本问题:量化证据的表述对代理人的回收和使用能力产生了多大影响?

blocks.en:
PlotGround provides a natural way to study this question because every benchmark instance links a plotted quantity to the source table from which its value is reconstructed. We can therefore hold the scientific question fixed while varying whether the agent has access to figures, source data, or both.
In particular, we ask what the agent gains when the same quantity can be recovered from structured data rather than estimated from pixels.
blocks.zh:
PlotGround提供了一个研究这个问题的自然方法,因为每个基准实例都将一个被绘图的数量与源表联系起来,而源表的值是从中重建出来的。 因此,我们可以将科学问题固定下来,同时改变制剂是否能够获得数字、源数据或两者。
我们特别询问,如果从结构化数据中而不是从像素中估算出同样数量,那么该物质将获得什么收益。

blocks.en: We rewrite questions from PlotGround-1k in the paper’s own terms. References to figures, panels, axes, and tables are removed so that the same question can be answered using either the figure or the underlying source data. For example, “In panel A, what is the log2 fold change of the point labeled CHAC1?” becomes “In the RNAseq differential expression analysis (DESeq2, compared to vehicle-treated cells) of HEK293T cells treated for 6 h with MBX-2982 (10 μ \mu M), what is the log2 fold change in expression of CHAC1?” (see Appendix C.2 for the rewriting prompt). During rewriting, we also flag and discard questions whose answers are stated directly in the manuscript text. The evaluation set consists of 500 randomly sampled questions that pass this filter.
blocks.zh: 我们用纸上的话重写来自PlotGround-1k的问题。 数字、面板、轴和表格的参考文献被删除,以便用数字或基础源数据回答同样的问题。 例如,“在面板A中,标记为CHAC1的点的对数2折叠变化是什么?” 变成“在用MBX-2982(10 μ\mu M)处理的6h的HEK293T细胞的RNAseq差分表达分析(与车辆处理的细胞相比)中,CHAC1的对数2折叠变化是什么?” (改写快件见附录C.2)。 在重写时,我们也标出和丢弃在手稿文本中直接说明答案的问题. 评价集由500个随机抽取的问题组成,通过这个过滤器.

blocks.en:
Claude Code (Claude Sonnet 5) then answers each question under three evidence conditions. Each run takes place in a Docker container holding the paper’s files, with the same prompt throughout (Appendix C.3 ). Only the contents of the working directory differ between conditions.
All three conditions include the full text (the article XML from the bioRxiv
submission package). The agent additionally receives figure images
( Figure ), supplementary data files ( Table ), or both

Access to structured source data substantially improves both accuracy and
efficiency (Table 3 ). With the figure alone, Claude Code reaches 90.0% accuracy, but each question costs $0.41 and takes 139 s on average. The agent takes about 26 turns per question, repeatedly cropping and enlarging the target panel and, in most runs, measuring pixel positions directly from the image array. blocks.en: During verification, we found 8 candidate questions (from 8 figures) with apparent discrepancies between the plotted values and those reconstructed from the associated source data. Our review did not identify errors in the reconstruction recipes that could account for these differences. Examples included a bar ending below 8 despite a reconstructed value of 8.28 (Figure 4 ), and a survival curve whose genotype labels appeared inconsistent with the source data (Supp Figure 6 ). We could not reconcile these differences using the available source data and manuscript descriptions, so we excluded these candidates from PlotGround-1k.

blocks.en: Although identifying figure–data discrepancies was not an objective of the pipeline, these cases suggest a practical application. Given that frontier models can often recover plotted values accurately (Section 4.3 ), the same three steps (mapping a figure to its source table, reconstructing the plotted quantity, and comparing it with the value read from the figure) could be used to flag potential figure–data inconsistencies for further inspection. On the 8 discrepant figures, GPT-5.6 Sol’s reading agrees with the figure rather than the table in every case. Since a model’s own reading errors also trigger such flags, the check currently serves best as a filter that narrows down candidates for human review, and it becomes more precise as reading accuracy improves.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced PlotGround, a pipeline for constructing plot digitization benchmarks from real scientific figures and their source data. The resulting benchmark, PlotGround-1k, contains 1,119 human-verified questions. Evaluation of 16 multimodal models reveals a remaining gap between approximate visual reading and precise numerical recovery. In our agentic evaluation, replacing figures with source tables improves accuracy while substantially reducing cost, highlighting the value of structured data for quantitative scientific workflows. We also identify figures whose plotted values disagree with their own deposited data, suggesting figure–data consistency checking as a downstream use of accurate plot digitization.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了PlotGround,这是从真实科学人物及其源数据中构建地块数字化基准的管道. 由此产生的基准PlotGround-1k包含1,119个经人验证的问题. 对16个多式联运模式的评价表明,在近似读取和精确数字恢复之间仍然存在差距。 在我们的代理评价中,用源表取而代之的数字提高了准确性,同时大大减少了成本,突出了结构化数据对定量科学工作流程的价值。 我们还确定了那些其绘图值与自己储存的数据不一致的数字,建议将数据一致性检查作为准确绘图数字化的下游用途。

blocks.en: PlotGround-1k is drawn from bioRxiv preprints that deposit tabular source data, so its current coverage is concentrated in biology and may not reflect figure conventions in other fields. However, the pipeline itself is not tied to bioRxiv. Journals that publish per-figure source data, such as those in the Nature Portfolio, could support similar benchmark construction in other disciplines. Our conservative grounding criteria and preference for clearly readable targets help ensure the reliability of the pipeline, but favor figures whose plotted values are relatively easy to verify. Performance on PlotGround-1k may therefore not generalize to the full range of scientific figures. In addition, although the pipeline is automated, PlotGround-1k is fully human-verified (the audit accepted 92.9% of candidates), and reducing the need for such review remains open. Finally, our evaluation focuses on recovering individual plotted values, an atomic operation in full plot digitization. PlotGround’s explicit links between figures and source data could facilitate extending this evaluation to complete data series. We leave these extensions to future work.
blocks.zh: PlotGround-1k取自存有表格源数据的生物Rxiv预印本,因此其目前的覆盖范围集中在生物学领域,可能不反映其他领域的数字常规. 然而,管道本身并没有与生物Rxiv挂钩. 按图源数据发布的期刊,如"自然组合"中的期刊,可以支持其他学科类似的基准构建. 我们保守的基础标准和对明确可读目标的偏好有助于确保管道的可靠性,但偏好那些其设计值比较容易核实的数字。 因此,PlotGround-1k的性能可能无法概括到所有科学人物。 此外,虽然管道是自动化的,但PlotGround-1k完全经过了人员核查(审计接受92.9%的候选人),减少这种审查的需要仍然没有定论。 最后,我们的评价侧重于恢复个人图定值,这是全面图定数字化的原子操作。 PlotGround在数字和源数据之间的明确联系有助于将这一评价扩大到完成数据系列。 我们把这些延期留给今后的工作。

figure of this paper. The question is currently phrased in terms of the drawing
(“panel”, “bar”, “point”, “y-axis”, …). Your job is to REWRITE it so

legends, labels, or anything about how the value is drawn. Do not mention

gold value; report the recomputed value. Read the figure caption and the
relevant text so the wording matches the paper. Then check whether the paper ITSELF already states the answer: search the full
text XML (abstract, results, methods, figure captions, any in-text tables) for

answer the question without the figure or the data (within a few percent), set value_in_text to true and quote the sentence. This does not change
how you write the question; such questions are simply excluded downstream. Return the result as a JSON object matching the required schema.
